🔥 Connect to Firebase Database

🔥
Firebase provides a free real-time database so your team can collaborate from anywhere in the world.

1 Create a free Firebase project

Go to console.firebase.google.com → Add project → name it (e.g. "rollout-tracker") → Continue.

2 Enable Realtime Database

In your project → Build → Realtime Database → Create database → choose Start in test mode → Enable.

3 Get your config

Project settings (gear icon) → General → scroll to Your apps → Add app → Web (</>) → register → copy the firebaseConfig object → paste below.

Free tier: 1 GB storage, 10 GB/month transfer — plenty for this tracker.
